brief:
Over 200 organizations plan to participate in a "Global Day of Action" for Palestine on Saturday, with demonstrations set to occur across 60 countries in more than 250 locations worldwide, Middle East Eye reported. The coordinated protests represent one of the largest synchronized advocacy efforts for the Palestinian cause.

Details on specific demands, participating groups, and protest locations were not immediately available.
